View def — General projection.description: view def specialized from `GeneralView` (generic projection — tables, lists, ad-hoc layouts). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — Interconnection (IBD).description: view def specialized from `InterconnectionView` (parts and the connections between them). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — ActionFlow.description: view def specialized from `ActionFlowView` (actions, their flow, decision/merge nodes). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — StateTransition.description: view def specialized from `StateTransitionView` (states and the transitions between them). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — Sequence.description: view def specialized from `SequenceView` (time-ordered message exchange between participants). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — Browser.description: view def specialized from `BrowserView` (model-tree projection — containment hierarchy). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — Grid.description: view def specialized from `GridView` (tabular / matrix projection of the exposed elements). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — Geometry.description: view def specialized from `GeometryView` (spatial layout of geometry-bearing parts). One of the 8 standard view definitions.

View def — Requirement projection.description: Requirement view: SysML v2 defines no RequirementView — a requirement view is a `GeneralView` exposing (and, once grammar support lands, filtering to) requirement elements.
